label: Bible Study
prompt: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in _____; for thou shalt die, and not live.
verse: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
note: King Hezekiah's bad news — but he prayed, wept, and God added fifteen years to his life.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as _____ is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
verse: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
note: God refines His people as silver is refined — the fire is for purifying, not destroying.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an _____ of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verse: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
note: Nebuchadnezzar's golden image stood threescore cubits high — and everyone was ordered to bow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let this _____ be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verse: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
note: The doorway to Paul's great passage on Christ's humility — what follows is the mindset he wants copied.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye said also, Behold, what a _____ is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
verse: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
note: Israel's priests sniffed at worship — 'what a weariness is it!' — then offered God the torn, the lame, and the sick.
